content.title: 不定式(to do)速查
content.intro: 不定式 to do 既可作目的状语、后置定语,也可作主语、宾语、表语和宾语补足语。判断口诀:看动词搭配和句法位置——该用不定式时,doing / done / 原形都不对;被动意义用 to be done,先于谓语用 to have done。

rows: (In order/So as) to do:I am writing to apply for the job.
n. + to do:the best way to prepare;the first thing to do
want/decide/hope to do;My goal is to land a job.
ask/advise/encourage sb to do:She advised us to make a plan.
how/what/where/whether + to do:I don't know how to start.
to be done:The CV needs to be tailored.
to have done:He seems to have read a lot about careers.

specialRules.rule: want/decide/hope/plan/wish/aim/choose 等只接不定式作宾语
ask/advise/encourage/tell/expect/require sb + to do 作宾补
specialRules.mark: advised us to make √ / advised us making ×

specialRules.rule: 主语承受动作时用被动不定式 to be done
too + adj. + to do(太……以致不能);adj. + enough + to do(足够……能……)
specialRules.mark: too nervous to speak;confident enough to present

why: 不定式表示'目的、将来或一次性的动作',这正是求职、规划职业时最常表达的意思(为了得到工作而准备、决定去做某事);所以这些语境里要用 to do,而不是表'正在/经常'的 doing 或表'被动完成'的 done。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:用所给动词的正确非谓语形式,常考 to do 与 doing / done 的区分(看搭配与逻辑主语)。
主动 vs 被动:to do 还是 to be done,看逻辑主语是动作的执行者还是承受者。
疑问词+to do 作宾语;in order to / so as to 表目的的同义替换。

examVsReal.exam: I am writing to apply for the position.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: I'm writing about the helper job.
examVsReal.note: 考试求职信偏好 to apply 表目的;真实邮件常更口语、直接点题

examVsReal.exam: The CV needs to be tailored.(考试,被动不定式)
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考被动不定式;口语里直接用主动句更自然
